job_description:
Frontend Engineer

We need a frontend engineer to grow our web app and design system. You will build React components, own accessibility, and work in TypeScript.

Requirements:
- 3+ years with React and TypeScript
- Experience building a component library or design system
- Strong accessibility and interaction design sensibility
- Comfort with Node.js tooling
notes: Strong frontend match, mid-level; React/TypeScript/design-system resume aligned to a frontend JD. Resume band 76-90 is the solid-mid tier. Match band 84-100 - every stack term in the JD is present; the two that stay unmatched ('System', 'Comfort') are keyword-extraction noise, not real requirements.
